card.name: The word ingestion after timing words
card.fires_on: The word "ingestion" right after "following", "prior to", "oral" or "accidental" in dosing and overdose text. It also fires on a few partial words such as "alter" in halter and "ac" in Titralac.

modes.label: Ingestion after a timing phrase
modes.description: "Ingestion" follows "following", "prior to", "oral" or "accidental" when describing when something happens relative to taking a drug.
modes.example: ER will continue to release oxycodone and add to the oxycodone load for 24 to 48 hours or longer following<< ingestion>> necessitating prolonged monitoring.

modes.label: Partway through rare words
modes.description: A middle piece of an uncommon word such as halter or Titralac.
